senses.gloss: f. (פָּשַׁר) [division, cmp. בָּצַע,] compromise, settlement (cmp. Samar. פשרונה for משפט, Ex. XXI, 1, a. fr.].
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 10:6">Keth. X, 6</cite> <he>עד שיעשו פ׳ ביניהם</he> until they agree to a division among them.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 1:2">Tosef. Snh. I, 2</cite> <he>כשם שהדין … כך הפ׳ בשלשה</he> as three judges are required for legal judgment, so are three required for arbitration; Bab.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 5b:14">ib. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>ופ׳ בשנים</he> a compromise is valid if made before two judges.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 5b:14">Ib.</cite> <he>שנים שעשו פ׳ וכ׳</he> when two judges have arbitrated, the parties cannot retract (v. <cite ref="Q02098"><he>פָּשַׁר</he></cite>). Y. ib. I, 18ᵇ, v. <cite ref="E00525"><he>הַכְרָעָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 95:1">Sifré Num. 95</cite> <he>פ׳ היא זו וכ׳</he> this is to be a compromise (between God and ourselves), he cannot give us what we demand.
